scope: Selected diagnostic review after the final frozen cohort replay; no tuning from Grok or holdout outcomes. Not an independent or exhaustive human fit review.

cases.finding: New librarian Top is supported by an existing explicit preference for organizing reference materials, checking accuracy and helping people find sources. It was missed by the control question path.

New mechanical-engineering Top uses existing stated enjoyment of building moving mechanisms, comparing motion, testing revised parts and comparing design trade-offs. No new engineering interest was assigned.
New writing Top uses an existing statement about writing original scenes or essays and revising structure after reader feedback.

lossReview: The separately recorded development loss cases miss prior final checks after earlier activity replacements. A specific-question guard is not a guarantee that an undiscovered career will be reached within24.
nextProposal: Test a one-replacement-per-original-question cap and protect a finishing allowance for promising unfinished careers using observed evidence only. Also benchmark confidence-based early stopping against the same24 maximum.
